meta.title: Our Class Timetable
meta.textType: functional: a school timetable with times

paragraphs: This is our class timetable. Our class is with Teacher Kim. She puts the timetable on the board. We have school every day from Monday to Friday. School starts at eight o'clock. On Monday at a quarter past eight, we have English. We have a computer lesson at half past nine. There is a break at ten o'clock. Lunch is at twelve o'clock. It is nice. Leo and May are my good friends. We always eat rice at lunch.

On Tuesday, we have music after lunch. Music is at one o'clock. We sing songs. On Wednesday at half past one, we draw pictures. On Thursday at two o'clock, we play football. On Friday at a quarter past two, we read stories. We have homework on Monday and Wednesday. We never have homework on Friday.

"Do we have English every day?" asks Leo. "No," says May. "We have English on Monday and Thursday." "What time is football?" asks Leo. "It's at two o'clock," says Lily. Teacher Kim sometimes reads a story before break. I like music, and I like football, too. Leo likes our timetable, too. What is your favorite lesson in the week?
text.summary: Lily tells us about her class timetable. It shows the times of English, computer lessons, music, football, and lunch for one week.
